metadata.title: Real-Time Messaging

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for synchronous, low-latency text-based communication supporting coordination and collaboration.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Real-time messaging platforms, chat backplanes, and live text collaboration services.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for enabling synchronous text communication with identity awareness, bounded participation, and accountability.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Real-time messages, delivery state, timestamps, participant identifiers, and conversation audit metadata.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Real-Time Messaging inherits baseline collaboration trust properties from Collaboration Core.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Real-time messaging frequently involves remote and unmanaged endpoints and must align with telework and BYOD guidance.

metadata.remarks: Real-Time Messaging defines synchronous, low-latency text communication used for live coordination and interactive collaboration. This pattern emphasizes immediacy, participant visibility, and conversational continuity, while inheriting identity, boundary, and accountability guarantees from Collaboration Core.

components.title: Participant Identity and Presence Awareness
components.description: Ensures participants in real-time messaging sessions are accurately identified and their presence is visible to others.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Masquerading through misleading display names or identity indicators in live messaging sessions.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of valid accounts to misrepresent authority or participate in unauthorized conversations.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strong identity binding and consistent identity presentation mitigate impersonation risks.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Participants in real-time messaging are authenticated and attributable.
Identity attributes are managed to ensure correct contextual representation.

components.title: Session Boundary and Participation Control
components.description: Constrains who may join, remain in, or observe real-time messaging sessions.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of trusted relationships to gain unauthorized access to live collaboration sessions.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Membership and role-based access control limit session participation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Access to real-time messaging sessions is explicitly managed.

components.title: Accountability and Observability
components.description: Provides traceability of real-time messaging activity to support governance, oversight, and investigation.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Deletion or suppression of evidence related to real-time messaging misuse.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging and activity tracing support accountability for live messaging.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Real-time messaging events are defined and logged.
Audit review supports detection and investigation of misuse.
